title: Understanding Critical Thinking in Generative Artificial Intelligence Use: Development, Validation, and Correlates of the Critical Thinking in AI Use Scale

bias_targets.methodology: Measured using the 13-item Marlowe-Crowne Social Desirability Scale Form C to ensure that self-reported scores on the Critical Thinking in AI Use Scale reflect genuine cognitive dispositions rather than a participant's desire to present themselves favorably or engage in impression management.
